completionRule: Every applicable check must pass with test evidence; N/A requires an explicit reason; source presence is never runtime completion; unresolved helper/unit records block full coverage

extraRequirements.label: Nightmare end / transfer command audit
extraRequirements.evidence: Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.   Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
extraRequirements.adaptation: wake/transfer interactions and target ownership; exact helper IDs require current-client confirmation

extraRequirements.label: Morph return / copied basic ability set
extraRequirements.evidence: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
extraRequirements.adaptation: original and copied forms; separate/copied cooldown contract

extraRequirements.label: Shadowraze variant closure audit
extraRequirements.evidence: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
extraRequirements.adaptation: only one variant record supplied; reconcile legacy range selector with current official client; do not invent additional IDs or ranges

extraRequirements.label: Ethereal Jaunt
extraRequirements.evidence:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.   Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
extraRequirements.adaptation: orb-linked recast; teleport to active orb

extraRequirements.label: Return
extraRequirements.evidence: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
extraRequirements.adaptation: mark-linked recast; friendly/enemy timing

extraRequirements.label: Eidolon unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
extraRequirements.adaptation: replication / attack counter / entity stats

extraRequirements.label: Primal companion unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
extraRequirements.adaptation: boar/hawk entities, attacks/abilities depending on current source

extraRequirements.label: Nature’s Call treant / greater treant unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
extraRequirements.adaptation: summon stats, unit ability catalog

extraRequirements.label: Infest consume / exit and host control
extraRequirements.evidence:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
extraRequirements.adaptation: host entity, voluntary explosion/exit, controlled creep abilities and target restrictions

extraRequirements.label: Controlled neutral unit ability catalog
extraRequirements.evidence:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
extraRequirements.adaptation: conversion requires complete neutral/unit ability registry

extraRequirements.label: Spiderling / spiderite unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
extraRequirements.adaptation: spawn chains, venom, unit stats

extraRequirements.label: Zealot sacrifice and controlled creep abilities
extraRequirements.evidence: Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen.  Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.
extraRequirements.adaptation: creep catalog and sacrifice heal/damage; controlled unit selection

extraRequirements.label: Ice Blast release command
extraRequirements.evidence: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
extraRequirements.adaptation: outgoing tracer and release timing; exact helper ID absent

extraRequirements.label: Unstable Concoction throw command
extraRequirements.evidence: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
extraRequirements.adaptation: brew then throw, self-stun on timeout; exact helper ID absent

extraRequirements.label: Forge Spirit unit attacks/abilities
extraRequirements.evidence: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of  Exort  while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of  Quas . The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of  Quas  and  Exort .
extraRequirements.adaptation: summon entity stats and own abilities unresolved

extraRequirements.label: Summon Wolves unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
extraRequirements.adaptation: unit stats and passive upgrades

extraRequirements.label: Primal Split warrior ability sets
extraRequirements.evidence: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
extraRequirements.adaptation: select earth/storm/fire entity; each complete ability bar; survivor/rebirth logic

extraRequirements.label: Spirit Bear ability set: Demolish / Return / Entangling Claws / Savage Roar / Spirit Link
extraRequirements.evidence:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.  If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
extraRequirements.adaptation: independent unit orders, health, cooldowns, leash, death backlash; exact subunit IDs/stats unresolved

extraRequirements.label: Clone selection and shared death contract
extraRequirements.evidence: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.   Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.  If any Meepo dies, they all die.
extraRequirements.adaptation: all clone orders and independent/shared resources

extraRequirements.label: Tombstone zombie unit catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
extraRequirements.adaptation: zombie spawns, attacks, slow stacks and tombstone interaction

extraRequirements.label: Tempest Double independent commands
extraRequirements.evidence: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.  The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.

If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.

extraRequirements.label: Wukong soldier entity catalog
extraRequirements.evidence: Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.  Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
extraRequirements.adaptation: soldier attacks, ownership, relocation and despawn constraints

extraRequirements.label: Shodo Sai cancel
extraRequirements.evidence: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.  Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.  The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
extraRequirements.adaptation: explicitly mentioned sub-ability ends parry; ID absent

extraRequirements.label: Amphibian Rhapsody end / beat timing contract
extraRequirements.evidence:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
extraRequirements.adaptation: songs replace main bar; explicit synchronized beat window; return to base bar
